headline: Technical shells worn by ski patrollers
body: Built for relentless days in the backcountry. Our technical fabrics deliver absolute protection when you push your limits in deep snow.
rationale: This persona cares deeply about professional validation and functional capability rather than luxury branding. Using the exact fact that ski patrollers wear these shells matches their desire for performance proof, while the low-medium price sensitivity means we skip discount talk and focus entirely on technical specs.
